summary.text: Michele Hoitenga is a Republican state senator from Michigan who represents District 36 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner and former mayor of Manton, she served in the Michigan House from 2017 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Michele Hoitenga, also known as Missy, lives in Manton, Michigan.

Her career experience includes co-owning PhD Consulting; she has served as mayor of Manton, treasurer and president of the Manton Chamber of Commerce, and vice chair of the Wexford County Republican Party.

Hoitenga represented District 102 in the Michigan House of Representatives from 2017 to 2023, chairing the Communications and Technology Committee, and she took office in the state Senate for District 36 on January 1, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Housing and Human Services, Local Government (as minority vice chair) and Natural Resources and Agriculture committees.
She advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.
